how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-the-stockade-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:386:obj:0: Bring the head of Targorr the Dread to Guard Berton in Lakeshire.
rows.quest:386:details:0: Targorr the Dread served under Gath'Ilzogg as supreme Executioner. His methods were ruthless, even by filthy orc standards. Men who fought bravely to defend the Kingdom were tortured on his whim. Now he is being held in the ⟦E1⟧ Stockade, sentenced to die. Yet something is amiss. One of the bureaucratic nobles put a hold on his execution. I am sure foul play is in the works.
rows.quest:386:details:1: Put an end to Targorr the Dread, ⟦1⟧. ⟦E2⟧ to The Stockade and behead him before trickery is upon us.
rows.quest:386:progress:0: Have you been to ⟦E1⟧ yet, to The Stockade? I ⟦E3⟧ whatever trickery that has kept Targorr the Dread alive for this long will eventually bring about his freedom. He was sentenced to die, ⟦2⟧, not act as some political pawn on a noble's whim.
rows.quest:386:completion:0: Targorr the Dread has finally met his fate. I for one am glad to hear the beast now knows what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death's ruthless grip. You have done well, ⟦3⟧. Sometimes the truest justice can only be found outside the courtroom and beyond the clouded vision of politics.
rows.quest:377:obj:0: Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants you to bring him the hand of Dextren Ward.
rows.quest:377:details:0: As if the neglect for the residents of ⟦E4⟧ was not bad enough, now the House of Nobles spits in the eye of the Darkshire Council with their decision to imprison Dextren Ward in ⟦E1⟧ rather than behead the villain as per Lord Ebonlocke's sentence.
rows.quest:377:details:1: Ward was caught selling bodies from the cemetery to ⟦E5⟧, a crime punishable by death. Yet ⟦E1⟧ claims Ward as their prisoner.
rows.quest:377:details:2: Assassinate Ward in The ⟦E1⟧ Stockade - bring me his hand - and I shall reward you.
rows.quest:377:progress:0: So long as a molester of the dead like Dextren Ward is permitted to live, justice stands betrayed. Return to me once Lord Ebonlocke's sentence of death is carried out on that defiler, Ward. We shall give the families of the dead the closure they deserve and better yet, we will send a clear message to the House of Nobles in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:377:completion:0: So Dextren Ward finally paid for his crimes against humanity? Good riddance to the scum I say. And cheers to you, my friend! Not only have you given the families of the dead the peace of mind they deserve, you sent a poignant message to those corrupt bureaucrats in the House of Nobles. ⟦E1⟧ must rise to the needs of the people of ⟦E4⟧ or we will break free from their tyranny.
rows.quest:387:obj:0: Warden Thelwater of ⟦E1⟧ wants you to kill 10 Defias Prisoners, 8 Defias Convicts, and 8 Defias Insurgents in The Stockade.
rows.quest:387:details:0: The uprising must be quelled! I need your assistance. If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job! This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one. But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:387:details:1: The punishment for insurgency is death. Kill some of these deviants! That ought to get things under control.
rows.quest:387:progress:0: The Stockade is still overrun! These Defias Rats must be shown that their actions will not be tolerated. Now get back down there and show some force!
rows.quest:387:completion:0: Your efforts in The Stockade were valiant, ⟦4⟧. It's obvious this problem is bigger than the both of us. But you have performed well and for that I am thankful.
rows.quest:388:obj:0: Nikova Raskol of ⟦E1⟧ wants you to collect 10 Red Wool Bandanas.
rows.quest:388:details:0: Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river. My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy. A mere 14 years old. When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city. He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up. Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their ⟦E6⟧ blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang. For that Mac was stabbed in the back.
rows.quest:388:details:1: I want revenge. Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas. They are the color of blood.
rows.quest:388:progress:0: I see you are back, ⟦5⟧. Have you collected 10 Red Wool Bandanas from those Defias Scum in The Stockade yet?
rows.quest:388:completion:0: So these bandanas -- filthy tokens of corruption -- are what my Mac had to die for? Such a waste. Such a tragic sacrifice. ⟦6⟧⟦7⟧But alas, I cannot return to the past. Just know, ⟦8⟧, that you have brought my family justice through your deeds.
rows.quest:378:obj:0: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.
rows.quest:378:details:0: You have proven your loyalty to King Magni, ⟦9⟧. And your hatred for the Dark Iron scum is as great as my own.
rows.quest:378:details:1: There is a task I wish to complete myself but I am bound by honor to stay with Longbraid. But Roggo has gathered intelligence that proves Kam Deepfury was a conspirator in the attack on the Thandol Span. It was by Deepfury's planning that Longbraid lost his kin.
rows.quest:378:details:2: Deepfury is being held for political reasons in the ⟦E1⟧ Stockade. I want him dead, ⟦10⟧. For Longbraid! Bring me his head!
rows.quest:378:progress:0: I won't let foolish ⟦E7⟧ bureaucracy interfere with Dwarven matters, ⟦11⟧. Kam Deepfury is a proven conspirator in the Thandol Span attack. King Magni's good people lost their lives because of Deepfury's deceit. The ⟦E8⟧ might be content to let Deepfury rot in The Stockade but I will not sleep soundly at night until Deepfury is slain.
rows.quest:378:completion:0: So Kam Deepfury finally got to feel what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death? Good. Serves the cowardly Dark Iron scum right. You have done well, ⟦12⟧. The victims of the Thandol Span attack were but mere victims in a world torn with war and unrest. Their families will have the peace of knowing Deepfury got the punishment he deserved. Longbraid's brother's death has been avenged.
rows.quest:391:obj:0: Kill ⟦E9⟧ and bring his head back to Warden Thelwater at the Stockade.
rows.quest:391:details:0: Let's get one thing straight, ⟦13⟧: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference.
rows.quest:391:details:1: So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
rows.quest:391:progress:0: Either you bring me Thredd's head, or I'll take yours, understand, ⟦14⟧?
rows.quest:391:completion:0: Without Thredd to lead them, hopefully the riots will be more controllable. We shall see.
rows.quest:391:completion:1: I must say, after a half hour, I hardly expected you to come out, but it seems I misjudged you.
rows.quest:391:completion:2: I'd guess, then, that you didn't get much useful information out of him? But I know a thing or two that might be of interest to you about Thredd's activities.
